title: Educator Oversight Remarks & Intervention Visibility (v0.4.43)
message: Teachers can now view & reply to School Admin and SDO remarks directly on materials, assessments, and student profiles.
changelog:
🏫 EDUCATOR OVERSIGHT & INTERVENTION UPDATE v0.4.43:
• School Admin & SDO Remarks on Mobile: Added live pedagogical remarks drawers and preview banners across Educator Home, Library PDF cards, PDF Reader, Weekly Assessments, and Quiz Overviews with direct teacher reply sync.
• Learner Intervention & Guidance Plans: Surfaced School Admin intervention statuses and guidance notes inside Class Performance rosters and Educator Student Profile sheets.
• Thread & Portal Role Attribution: Fixed announcement reply labels for teachers and added dedicated Educator Reply badges inside the Web Admin Portal remarks feed.
